Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

veryMAD (development version)

Added

  • Added raw-scale MAD cutoff overlays to plot_mad_qc_scatter() when given a matching mad_qc() report.
  • Added a 10,000-cell SPARSim vignette with a composed, batch-aware QC plot.

Changed

  • Reduced point size and opacity to keep dense QC plots readable.

veryMAD 0.7.0 - 2026-10-14

Added

  • Added batch-specific and reference-set thresholds to mad_qc().
  • Added plot_mad_qc() for batch distributions and plot_mad_qc_scatter() for paired metrics with per-batch Spearman rho and finite-pair counts.

Changed

  • Clarified Seurat metric definitions and QC review guidance.

veryMAD 0.6.0 - 2026-10-14

Added

  • Added threshold counts and report-only output to mad_qc().
  • Added single-cell examples and a reproducible benchmark.

Changed

  • Set mad_scale() to zero_mad = "na" by default; "zero" uses a unit denominator and returns unscaled deviations when centered.
  • Reserved id and mad_qc_outlier as metric names in mad_qc().

veryMAD 0.5.1 - 2026-08-06

Added

  • Established mad_qc() and mad_scale() as the public API.
  • Added the combined mad_qc_outlier flag and compact report printing.

veryMAD 0.5.0 - 2026-08-06

Added

  • Introduced explicit metric settings, annotation and report output, and robust scaling for vectors and matrices.
  • Added Seurat metadata support, raw-scale thresholds, and unresolved flags for zero MAD.
